newsitem.title: USA: Connie Lee Insurance says Q4 earnings up 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Connie Lee Insurance says Q4 earnings up 10.8 pct.

text.p: Connie Lee Insurance Co said Monday its net earnings in the fourth quarter of 1996 rose 10.8 percent to $2.9 million.
For the year as a whole, the municipal bond insurance company said net earnings rose 28.4 percent to $10.9 million from $8.5 million in 1995.

"In 1996, Conne Lee generated record earnings growth," Oliver Sockwell, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement. "These results position Connie Lee well for future growth and expansion as a fully private company."
Connie Lee last week completed its privatization with the repurchase for $18.4 million of its common stock from the U.S. Department of Education.
The company said it insured $815 million of municipal bonds in 1996, down from $870.1 million the year before. Net premiums also dropped, to $15.9 million for the year from $16.2 million in 1995.
Consolidated revenues rose 23.1 percent for the year, to $24.4 million.
